title: Frank & Atticus – Nut Brittle RY4 100ml
description:
Frank & Atticus – Nut Brittle RY4 100ml
Frank & Atticus’ Nut Brittle RY4 is a fantastic take on the classic RY4 tobacco flavour, with vanilla and caramel tones that are rich and sweet in equal measure.
A sweet toffee flavour cuts through the roasted nuts, bringing all of the flavours together into an earthy, somewhat woody, sweet tobacco experience.
Frank & Atticus vape juices come in 100ml bottles with 0MG nicotine. If you love dessert e-liquids, the Frank & Atticus juice range is a must-try!
